title: Pat Price remote views denied Soviet sites with gores and steel spheres

tellings.quote: not only reported on them with accuracy he talked about machinery and stuff there like a big Tower

plain: In the early 1970s, a man named Pat Price is said to have used remote viewing, the claimed practice of describing a distant place by the mind alone, to describe closed Soviet sites, and he got them right, down to the machinery there and "a big Tower". Joe McMoneagle, a guest who talks on the show about remote viewing, passes on what Price told him. He says Price "not only reported on them with accuracy" but described what stood inside, which, if true, would mean the mind can spy where no plane or agent could go.
